mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a warm 88 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park, feeling closer to 90. Clear conditions will persist into the evening, offering an excellent opportunity to spot the waxing crescent moon and watch the International Space Station pass over starting at 10:19 PM.

The City of Verona is sharing sustainability updates. For apartment residents, composting is made easy with the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located at 1220 East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city continues to improve local transportation by installing anti-idling tech in the new ambulance and maintaining its recognition as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community.

We have a busy calendar ahead. On July 18th, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. On July 22nd, don't miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

On Monday, July 6th, a Verona officer attempted to pull over a black sport motorcycle operating without a license plate, but the driver fled at high speeds and blew through red lights. The officer wisely chose not to pursue due to safety risks.
Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to enjoy their delicious Mint Cookie flavor of the day. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Turtle.
